# Invented offline fixtures only

These four deterministic JSON files are hand-constructed dummy responses for
Step 6B integration testing, not actual LLM outputs. `dummy-family-*` fields do
not identify real providers. Timestamp metadata is fixed, not a request log.
See `docs/llm_bridge_v2_implementation.md` for expected admission decisions and
scientific limits. No observed data, secret keys, generator truth or SHARE
statistics are used to create these records.
